Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The study analyzed three distinct fractions via MS: whole cell lysates, cell-derived ECM, and conditioned medium (CM). Per precedence rules, while CM and ECM are subproteomes/secretomes, the inclusion of the 'cell proteome' (lysed cells) justifies the 'whole cell lysate' scope as the broadest analyzed material. The CM was enriched using Strataclean-resin, but this is a recovery method for a biofluid rather than affinity-purification of a specific protein complex.
